title: Understanding the Objective Function
text: The objective function $R(\theta)=1/3*sum{i\=1}{3}{(x_i-\theta)**2}$ is a measure of how far the data points are from the value $\theta$. To minimize this function, we need to find a $\theta$ that makes the sum of squared differences as small as possible.

title: Mean as a Minimizer
text: The mean of a dataset is often used to minimize the sum of squared differences. Calculate the mean of the data points {1, $$6$$, 17} to see if it minimizes the objective function.

title: Verify the Minimization
